description: This file provides a client SDK for interacting with Feishu (Lark) via the '@larksuiteoapi/node-sdk'. It includes functions for creating and caching clients, handling HTTP timeouts, proxy agents, and WebSocket connections, as well as configuration management.

methods.name: getWsProxyAgent
methods.description: Retrieves the WebSocket proxy agent based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveDomain
methods.description: Resolves the domain string to a Lark.Domain or custom URL.

methods.name: createTimeoutHttpInstance
methods.description: Creates an HTTP instance with a default request timeout.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredHttpTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the HTTP timeout in milliseconds based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: createFeishuClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Feishu client for an account.

methods.name: createFeishuWSClient
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket client for a Feishu account.

methods.name: createEventDispatcher
methods.description: Creates an event dispatcher for a Feishu account.

methods.name: getFeishuClient
methods.description: Retrieves a cached Feishu client for an account if available.

methods.name: clearClientCache
methods.description: Clears the client cache for a specific account or all accounts.

methods.name: setFeishuClientRuntimeForTest
methods.description: Overrides SDK and proxy agent for testing purposes.
